entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. For questions about an existing order, press 1. For returns or exchanges, press 2. To speak with a sales representative, press 3.
Two.
Thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Sam. How can I help you today?
Hi Sam, I need to return a VeloBand Pulse. I got it about five days ago and it's just not what I expected.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your order number or the email address associated with your VeloFit account?
Sure, the email is marc.stevens@email.com.

Thank you, Marc. I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse, delivered five days ago. You are within the 10-day return window. Can you tell me about the condition of the item? Has it been opened or used?
Yeah, I wore it for a couple of days to track my workouts, but the interface feels clunky. I just want to send it back and get a refund.

I see. Unfortunately, Marc, according to our return policy, the VeloBand Pulse cannot be returned for a refund once it has been used. Due to hygiene reasons and the device being paired to a user's account, we are unable to accept it back.
What? That's ridiculous. How am I supposed to know if I like it without trying it on? That is completely **unacceptable**.
I do understand your frustration, but this policy is stated on the product page and in the terms and conditions at checkout. We cannot resell a used health tracking device.
This is absurd. I've used products from Whoop and my wife has a Peloton, and their customer service is way better. They understand you need to try something. I want to **speak to your boss**.
Sir, I can assure you my **supervisor** will tell you the same policy. It's a firm rule we cannot override. I can, however, offer you a $25 store credit for the misunderstanding.
A $25 credit on a $150 device you won't take back? That's an insult. Get me your **manager** on the phone right now. I'm not accepting this.
I understand you wish to escalate this. Please hold one moment while I connect you.
Hello, Mr. Stevens. My name is Anya, I'm a supervisor here at VeloFit. I understand you're unhappy with our return policy for the VeloBand Pulse.

Unhappy is an understatement. Your agent just told me I'm stuck with a $150 piece of plastic because I had the audacity to actually try it. Do you realize how anti-consumer that is? Competitors would never get away with that.

I certainly hear your frustration, and I want to apologize that your experience didn't meet your expectations. The policy is in place for customer safety. Once the VeloBand is used, we cannot guarantee its hygienic condition for another customer, and its internal data logs are permanently tied to the first user for privacy. We can't wipe it and resell it.
So you're just confirming what he said? You're not going to do anything for me? I can't get a refund?

I cannot process a refund for a used VeloBand Pulse; that is correct. I am sorry, but the policy is firm. The offer for a $25 store credit for the inconvenience still stands, but a return for a full refund isn't possible in this situation.
Unbelievable. Just forget it. I'll make sure other people know about this policy. This is the last time I ever buy anything from VeloFit.
